title: Expose HumbleControl localhost connection manifest
summary: Start the HumbleStudio-to-HumbleControl connection layer by exposing a read-only localhost manifest that HumbleControl can consume and by making the HumbleControl supported-app card load the local `.humble/design.json` export before the remote URL fallback.
acceptance_criteria: The localhost preview helper exposes a read-only connection index at `/api/connections` and a HumbleControl-specific manifest at `/api/connections/humble-control`.

The HumbleControl manifest identifies HumbleStudio as the producer, HumbleControl as the intended consumer, and lists supported local export endpoints with source kind, state, repo path, and Studio load URL.

Clicking HumbleControl in the supported-app catalog on localhost loads `/Users/janpokorny/Coding/personal/apps/HumbleControl/.humble/design.json` through an allowlisted helper endpoint before falling back to the remote raw GitHub URL.
The HumbleControl local export path is read-only and does not run arbitrary commands or mutate the HumbleControl repository.
The localhost helper tests and web fallback check cover the HumbleControl resolver and connection manifest contract.

evidence.note: Local preview helper tests now cover the connection manifest, HumbleControl JSON export reuse, missing export without generator, and prior HumbleSudoku paths.
A running localhost helper returned a connection index with the HumbleControl connection endpoint.
A running localhost helper returned the read-only HumbleControl manifest with HumbleControl and HumbleSudoku export descriptors.
The HumbleControl export endpoint returned `Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8`, `X-HumbleStudio-Local-Export: 1`, and `X-HumbleStudio-App-Id: humble-control`.
The local HumbleControl design export parsed as JSON and reported `HumbleControl` as the design contract name.
The web loader can syntactically handle both bundle and JSON responses from the localhost helper.
The web fallback integrity check now verifies HumbleControl resolver and connection manifest fragments.
The localhost helper and tests compile.
The repo status file and HS-0093 ticket JSON stayed valid.
The repo-native HS ticket surface validates with HS-0093 solved.
The local repo contract still validates against the shared HumbleControl-owned standard.
Workflow-only local checks passed for tickets, contract, script compilation, web fallback, and diff hygiene.

trigger.source_ref: Jan said he wants to gradually add connections into HumbleControl and asked whether HumbleStudio can be connected.

agent_notes: This slice intentionally does not change the HumbleControl repository; it gives HumbleControl a stable localhost manifest to consume in a follow-up HC ticket.
The HumbleControl local export resolver is read-only because the HumbleControl `.humble/design.json` already exists and no generator is configured.
The manifest is the first connection contract; future slices should move the duplicated web/native supported-app catalog into a shared file before adding more apps.
